title: CarbonBench: A Global Benchmark for Upscaling of Carbon Fluxes Using Zero-Shot Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.09868v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Accurately quantifying terrestrial carbon exchange is essential for climate policy and carbon accounting, yet models must generalize to ecosystems underrepresented in sparse eddy covariance observations. Despite this challenge being a natural instance of zero-shot spatial transfer learning for time series regression, no standardized benchmark exists to rigorously evaluate model performance across geographically distinct locations with different climate regimes and vegetation types.   We introduce CarbonBench, the first benchmark for zero-shot spatial transfer in carbon flux upscaling. CarbonBench comprises over 1.3 million daily observations from 567 flux tower sites globally (2000-2024). translated_title: CarbonBench：利用零样本学习进行碳通量升尺度的全球基准
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.09868v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：准确量化陆地碳交换对于气候政策和碳核算至关重要，然而模型必须泛化到稀疏涡度协方差观测中代表性不足的生态系统。尽管这一挑战是时间序列回归中零样本空间迁移学习的自然实例，但目前尚无标准化基准来严格评估模型在不同地理位置、不同气候条件和植被类型上的表现。我们引入了CarbonBench，这是碳通量升尺度中零样本空间迁移的首个基准。CarbonBench包含全球567个通量塔站点（2000-2024年）的超过130万条每日观测数据。它提供了：（1）分层评估协议，明确测试模型在未见植被类型和气候制度上的泛化能力，将空间迁移与时间自相关分离；（2）一套协调一致的遥感与气象数据。
tldr: 本文提出了CarbonBench，这是首个用于碳通量升尺度的零样本空间迁移基准，包含全球567个通量塔的130万条观测数据，并设计了分层评估协议以严格测试跨未见植被和气候的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CarbonBench, the first benchmark for zero-shot spatial transfer in carbon flux upscaling, comprising 1.3 million observations from 567 global flux tower sites with stratified evaluation protocols to rigorously test generalization across unseen vegetation and climate regimes.
